summary: Fast frontend-only regression after Landing.jsx CSS-only refactor (centered single column: hero on top, interaction card directly below). All critical landing + auth smoke flows pass. No visual or functional regression vs iteration_66.
verified_flows: Landing /login renders single centered column at 1440px: hero (max-w-2xl) and card (max-w-md) both horizontally centered at x=720 (viewport center); no left/right split
All required data-testids present and visible on /login: landing-home, landing-search-input, landing-search-btn, landing-signin, landing-create-portal, landing-apply-care
Search 'Aguayo' -> landing-result-dr-aguayo visible; click navigates to /register/dr-aguayo
landing-signin opens landing-roles with role-patient, role-clinic, role-partner; landing-role-back returns to landing-home; role-patient -> /signin
/signin shows google-signin-button; login with maria.lopez@demo.com / Patient2026! via login-email/login-password/login-submit lands on /portal
landing-create-portal -> /register (FindClinic search-only, no find-code-input testid present)
Mobile viewport 390x844: content stacks naturally and remains readable/tappable (confirmed via screenshot)
notes: OHIP=No -> np-status reveal was not reachable in this run because /register?new=1 opens FindClinic first (clinic selection prerequisite). This is pre-existing behavior, not touched by this layout-only change, and was previously verified in iteration_66.

Initial automated 'not-stacked' bbox check was a false negative: the `.max-w-md` CSS selector also matched the tagline paragraph INSIDE the hero. Screenshots clearly confirm hero is above card (vertically stacked, both centered).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing layout is now a single centered column (flex flex-col items-center): hero max-w-2xl on top, interaction card max-w-md directly below, emergency notice below card. HomePanel/RolePanel internals unchanged. If writing stacking checks, do NOT select by `.max-w-md` alone (matches tagline inside hero); use `[data-testid="landing-home"]`'s closest `.max-w-md` wrapper instead.
